reason: A DSH performance utility focused on reducing fork, projection, materialization, and cold-session memory costs for very large sessions through internal runtime patches, cache management, chunked persistence, and a local configuration API.

summaries.zh: 面向 DSH 超大会话的性能优化插件，通过内部方法补丁、分片预热、分片持久化和冷会话缓存裁剪来降低部分操作的阻塞与内存开销。
summaries.en: A DSH performance optimization plugin that reduces selected large-session fork, projection, persistence, and memory costs through internal patches, chunked processing, and cold-session cache trimming.

capabilities: Monkey-patches internal DSH session, persistence, projection, and preparation methods
Optimizes large-session forks through shared immutable event data
Warms projection caches incrementally and backfills fork caches
Materializes session data into chunked zstd frames
Trims the cold-session LRU cache and checks the V8 heap limit
Exposes a local HTTP API for statistics and runtime configuration
Persists runtime configuration changes and probes DSH version compatibility
